title: Firefly Neuroscience Forms Strategic Partnership with Neurology Consultants of Dallas (NCD) to Enhance Early Detection Efforts and Disease Management for Patients with Cognitive Disorders
description: Firefly Neuroscience and Neurology Consultants of Dallas (NCD) have formed a strategic partnership to integrate Firefly's Brain Network Analytics (BNA) technology into NCD's patient management protocols, aiming to enhance early detection and disease management for patients with cognitive disorders.

title: Firefly Neuroscience CEO Jon Olsen to Present at H.C. Wainwright’s 26th Annual Global Investment Conference September 9-11
description: Firefly Neuroscience, an AI company developing solutions to improve brain health, announced that its CEO will present at an investment conference. The company's FDA-cleared Brain Network Analytics (BNA) platform aims to enhance diagnosis and treatment monitoring for various neurological and mental disorders.

title: 4 Biotech Stocks With AI, Machine Learning Prowess
description: The article discusses four biotech companies leveraging AI and machine learning technology to improve drug discovery and development processes. These companies are Absci, Firefly Neuroscience, Korro Bio, and NeuroSense Therapeutics.

title: Firefly Neuroscience Reports Third Quarter 2024 Results and Provides Stockholder Update
description: Firefly Neuroscience, a Nasdaq-listed AI company, announced its Q3 2024 financial results and provided updates on its partnerships with pharmaceutical companies like Bright Minds Bioscience, Novartis, and Takeda to advance its Brain Network Analytics (BNA) technology for neurological and mental disorder treatments.
